items.title: How a programmatic DOOH ad plays
steps: A screen is ready for its next spot
The SSP sends the ad opportunity to buyers
A DSP bids for the spot
The winning ad is sent to the screen
The ad plays on the screen
items.why: The screen asks for an ad, the auction picks one, and proof of play closes the loop.

items.title: How a DOOH campaign is booked
steps: Review proof of play and results
items.why: Plan the where and when first, then buy, approve, run and review.
